title: My Dress-Up Darling
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Wakana Gojo, a reclusive high-school boy who crafts heads for hina dolls, hides his hobby after a childhood friend mocked it. His outgoing classmate Marin Kitagawa discovers his skill and asks him to make her cosplay costumes, and their collaboration grows into a romance that, per Wikipedia, ends in marriage and a daughter.
life_message: Holds up loving your craft and your interests openly, and finding people who accept you as you are.
